desc: Basketball was invented in December 1891 when teacher James Naismith nailed two peach baskets to a gym balcony in Springfield, Massachusetts. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.

lines.text: How did basketball start? With two peach baskets.
In December eighteen ninety one, a teacher named James Naismith needed an indoor game for winter.
He nailed two peach baskets to a gym balcony in Massachusetts.
Players used a soccer ball, and someone had to climb up and fetch it after every score.
Today the game has grown into a global sport played by hundreds of millions of people.
